name: Negative Influences
overview: Scripture teaches that negative influences can be countered by delighting in God's law and meditating on it continually, as this grounds the believer in truth (Psalms 1:2). The renewing of the mind is essential to resist conformity to worldly patterns and to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Believers are encouraged to focus their thoughts on what is true, honest, just, pure, and praiseworthy, which fosters spiritual strength and guards against harmful influences (Philippians 4:8). Additionally, godly fellowship sharpens and strengthens us, providing positive influence contrary to negative associations (Proverbs 27:17), while prayer with thanksgiving sustains peace and reliance on God amid challenges (Philippians 4:6).
